questions.stem: Which statement correctly describes what happens in an endothermic reaction?

options.text: More energy is released forming new bonds than is needed to break old bonds
More energy is required to break old bonds than is released forming new bonds
No bonds are broken during the reaction
The products have less energy than the reactants

questions.explanation: In an endothermic reaction, more energy is required to break the bonds in the reactants than is released when new bonds form in the products. This means the products have more energy than the reactants, and the extra energy is absorbed from the surroundings.

questions.stem: Photosynthesis is classified as an endothermic reaction. Which statement best explains why?

options.text: It releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
It absorbs light energy from the sun, storing it in glucose molecules
It produces oxygen as a waste product
It occurs only in the presence of chlorophyll

questions.explanation: Photosynthesis is endothermic because it absorbs light energy from the sun. This energy is used to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose, which stores more chemical energy than the reactants. The products have more energy than the reactants.
